parent_registry.parent_standard_state: Pure liquid ZnO at 1 bar, constructed from TSIV Table 1603.

range_flags: The JANAF liquid-Zn standard is tabulated above its 1180.173 K one-bar fugacity marker; this is a liquid reference state, not a vapor-pressure claim.

construction.method: Fit JANAF liquid-Zn H-H(298.15 K) and S nodes to the condensate phi polynomial. G(T)=(Hf,298+Hinc)×1000−T×S; coefficients were fitted to source nodes, not melt activity or battery data.

provenance.source: NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, Fourth Edition, Zn-003, liquid zinc; Chase (1998).
provenance.selection_rationale: Direct liquid-Zn JANAF H and S nodes set the elemental liquid standard. The 298.15 K liquid reference enthalpy is the printed +6.519 kJ/mol; the source fit spans 1200–2000 K and has a maximum Gibbs residual of 0.575 J/mol.

fit_residual.target_source: NIST-JANAF Zn-003 liquid zinc H and S rows at 1200–2000 K
fit_residual.comparison_method: Maximum absolute Gibbs residual of the quartic condensate-phi fit against the printed H and S nodes.

band_basis.explanation: The 0.575 J/mol value is a polynomial transcription residual, not a thermochemical accuracy interval; JANAF does not supply a numeric uncertainty for these nodes.

independent_check.reason: No independent liquid-Zn standard-state check was identified.

range_flags: The liquid branch is constructed below the 2250 ± 30 K melting point; ΔHfus and liquid Cp are estimates, not independent measured liquid-property rows.

construction.derivation: TSIV Table 1603 uses ΔfH°298(ZnO,cr)=-350.5 kJ/mol. At 2250 K its printed H°−H°(0) values are 112.162 kJ/mol for crystal and 182.162 kJ/mol for liquid, so ΔHfus=182.162−112.162=70.000 kJ/mol, matching the reported 70±10 kJ/mol estimate. The liquid Cp is estimated as 67 J mol^-1 K^-1. The shipped condensate coefficients are reused unchanged.

provenance.source: TSIV, thermodynamic properties of ZnO(cr,l), Table 1603; source values and constructed liquid branch.
provenance.selection_rationale: Reuse the immutable default ZnO(l) condensate row sourced to TSIV Table 1603. Its crystal formation enthalpy is based on matched acid-solution calorimetry; fusion enthalpy and liquid heat capacity are explicitly estimated by the source.

band_basis.explanation: The 70±10 kJ/mol fusion estimate does not bound the estimated liquid heat capacity or the extrapolated standard Gibbs function; no complete accuracy interval is claimed.

independent_check.reason: No independent ZnO(l) standard-state check is added; the shipped source construction is retained without refitting.

range_flags: imcc_zn_activity_domain_notice: this is a provisional single-associate willemite construction, not a calibrated ZnO activity model for phosphate-poor basalt or regolith melts.
The liquid standard is supercooled below 1785.15 K and uses a constant oxide-additive liquid Cp estimate; no direct Zn2SiO4(l) Cp measurement is represented.
The measured α→β transition near 1773.15 K is included; no additional composition-dependent interaction data are supplied.

construction.solid_formation_enthalpy_derivation: King (1951), Table III, p. 657: 2ZnO(cr)+SiO2(quartz)→Zn2SiO4(cr), ΔH=-6990±140 cal/mol. Re-anchor to TSIV ZnO ΔfH°=-350.500 kJ/mol and JANAF quartz ΔfH°=-910.857 kJ/mol: 2(-350.500)+(-910.857)+(-6990×4.184/1000)=-1641.10316 kJ/mol. Barin's compiled -1641.5671 kJ/mol differs by 0.464 kJ/mol, within the source and oxide-anchor uncertainty.
construction.crystal_heat_capacity_source: Barin (1989), transcribed by Jeon et al. (2025), Table 2, p. 47006; equation in J mol^-1 K^-1 over 298–1800 K.

alpha_beta_transition.source: Zaitseva et al. (2019), Table 1 and Fig. 4, p. 3.

construction.liquid_heat_capacity_estimate_derivation: Cp[Zn2SiO4(l)]≈2Cp[ZnO(l)]+Cp[SiO2(l)]=2(67)+81.39=215.39 J mol^-1 K^-1. The ZnO liquid Cp is estimated in TSIV Table 1603; the silica liquid Cp at the fusion anchor is based on Richet et al. (1984), DOI 10.1111/j.1151-2916.1984.tb19155.x. The sum is held constant from 1200–2000 K as a provisional estimate.
construction.liquid_standard_algebra: Integrate the Barin crystal Cp equation from 298.15 K to 1785.15 K; add the measured 0.13 kJ/mol α→β transition at 1773.15 K; add ΔHfus=106.44 kJ/mol and ΔSfus=ΔHfus/Tfus. Continue the liquid as H_l(T)=H_cr(Tfus)+ΔHfus+Cp_l(T−Tfus) and S_l(T)=S_cr(Tfus)+ΔSfus+Cp_l ln(T/Tfus). Fit G=(Hf,298+Hinc)×1000−T×S to the existing condensate-phi row form.

provenance.source: King (1951), willemite formation enthalpy from ZnO and quartz; Barin crystal S and Cp as transcribed by Jeon et al. (2025); Zaitseva et al. (2019), transition and fusion; oxide-additive estimated liquid Cp.
provenance.selection_rationale: The reaction enthalpy is a primary calorimetric value re-anchored to the active ZnO and quartz standards. A directly observed willemite transition and melting event set the phase steps. The absent liquid Cp is filled only by a flagged oxide-additive estimate; no phosphate activity measurements or battery rows select this row.

fit_residual.target_source: Willemite crystal H and S reconstructed from printed Barin Cp and S298, King formation enthalpy, and Zaitseva transition/fusion anchors with the stated liquid-Cp estimate.
fit_residual.comparison_method: Maximum absolute Gibbs residual of the quartic condensate-phi fit over nine 100 K nodes from 1200–2000 K.

band_basis.explanation: The fusion enthalpy has no stated uncertainty and the oxide-additive liquid Cp has no measured uncertainty. The polynomial residual is only a numerical fit check; a quantitative accuracy interval is not supportable.
band_basis.provenance: King (1951); Zaitseva et al. (2019); Barin (1989) as transcribed by Jeon et al. (2025).

independent_check.reason: No independent Zn2SiO4(l) activity measurement in a regolith-like melt was identified; phosphate-family activity data are outside this row's standard-state derivation.

rows.phase_or_construction: Pure liquid ZnO standard retained from the immutable TSIV-1603 condensate row; fusion and liquid Cp follow the published construction.
rows.method: Assemble product-positive Gibbs terms with the JANAF liquid-Zn, O2(g), and TSIV ZnO(l) standards.
rows.uncertainty_note: The ZnO fusion enthalpy is estimated as 70±10 kJ/mol and its liquid Cp is estimated as 67 J mol^-1 K^-1; no complete reaction accuracy band is claimed.
range_flags: Zn(l) uses a JANAF liquid reference above its one-bar fugacity marker; the standard remains a condensed liquid reference.

provenance.source: NIST-JANAF Zn-003 liquid zinc and O-029 oxygen; TSIV Table 1603 ZnO(cr,l).
provenance.selection_rationale: The liquid-metal and oxygen standards are direct JANAF functions; the product reuses the TSIV ZnO liquid construction without changing the shipped table.

band_basis.explanation: The reaction inherits the source ZnO fusion and liquid-Cp estimates; no complete numeric band is available.

independent_check.reason: No independent liquid-Zn oxidation check is added in this fragment.

rows.phase_or_construction: Willemite-derived liquid association standard from the independently sourced crystal formation enthalpy, measured transition and fusion, and a provisional oxide-additive liquid Cp estimate.
rows.method: Assemble product-positive Gibbs terms with the constructed Zn2SiO4(l) standard and existing ZnO(l)/SiO2(l) standards.
rows.uncertainty_note: The King reaction enthalpy and Barin crystal function are source-grounded; the direct fusion enthalpy has no stated uncertainty and the liquid Cp is an unbounded oxide-additive estimate. No statistical or accuracy interval is claimed.
range_flags: imcc_zn_activity_domain_notice: provisional willemite single-associate model; no general lunar-basalt or phosphate-poor ZnO activity calibration is established.
The liquid standard is supercooled below 1785.15 K and uses an estimated constant liquid Cp over 1200–2000 K.

provenance.source: King (1951), Table III, p. 657; Barin (1989) crystal data as transcribed in Jeon et al. (2025), Table 2, p. 47006; Zaitseva et al. (2019), Table 1 and Fig. 4, p. 3; Richet et al. (1984).
provenance.selection_rationale: The independent primary formation reaction and fusion event determine the solid and phase-change anchors. Crystal Cp is taken from the published Barin assessment; missing liquid Cp is filled by an explicit estimate. The phosphate activity family is not used to select or fit the row.

fit_residual.target_source: Printed crystal Cp, formation and fusion anchors, and estimated liquid Cp recorded in the Zn2SiO4(l) standard construction.
fit_residual.comparison_method: Maximum absolute Gibbs residual of the source-node quartic fit.

band_basis.explanation: The fit residual is not a thermochemical accuracy measure; the dominant estimated liquid Cp has no reported uncertainty.
band_basis.provenance: King (1951); Zaitseva et al. (2019); Jeon et al. (2025).

independent_check.reason: The available ZnO-phosphate vapor data do not validate a willemite-derived associate in a silicate regolith melt and were not used as a calibration target.

flags.message: Report this notice whenever the Zn2SiO4(l) row participates: the single-associate activity model is a thermochemical estimate, not a measured or broadly calibrated ZnO activity model for phosphate-poor basalt/regolith melts.

battery_smoke.reason: The joined battery coverage has no complete composition or oxygen-fugacity inputs for these points; the points are also below the stated process window. No source values are inferred and no predicted-versus-printed pair is supportable.
